Child Hub Navigation (Today's Quests, My Schedule, Side Quests, My Portfolio, Trophy Room / Feedback)

component_guidelines.buttons: Pill or rounded-xl buttons with clear hover glow, active press state, and zero lag. Primary actions use solid navy or teal with contrast white text.
component_guidelines.cards: Subtle 1px border (#E2E8F0 or dark equivalent), subtle shadow-sm, backdrop-blur where floating. Containers MUST have internal padding (p-5 or p-6) to prevent text collision.
component_guidelines.modal_dialogs: Use Shadcn Dialog/Sheet with fixed backdrop blur (bg-slate-900/40 backdrop-blur-md). NEVER transparent backdrops.
component_guidelines.navigation_bar: Sticky glass header with backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/80 dark:bg-slate-900/80 with child persona indicator badge.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a dual persona toggle or quick switch top bar so user can instantly switch between Parent Hub and Child Hub view.
Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes (e.g. data-testid='parent-nav-dashboard', data-testid='child-task-card-1', data-testid='ai-generator-submit-button').
Support full NSW Australia K-12 curriculum stages: Early Stage 1 (K), Stage 1 (Y1-2), Stage 2 (Y3-4), Stage 3 (Y5-6), Stage 4 (Y7-8), Stage 5 (Y9-10), Stage 6 (Y11-12).
Implement the explicit teaching sequence step-by-step viewer for lessons.
Ensure status pills and licence badges use the exact color scheme specified above.
Use sonner for notifications and toasts.
Do NOT use Inter for main headings; use Outfit or Barlow font classes.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attributes.
Do NOT center align the main app container.
Do NOT use AI emoji characters like 🤖🧠 in headings or buttons.
Never use transparent backgrounds under dropdowns or modals.
Use proper padding p-6 or p-8 inside bordered cards.
